scope: Defined v1: a shared engine and GUI, qualified Python/Windows, Android and .NET builds, and foundations for Linux/macOS runners. 100% covers this release scope; support for additional languages and formats has a separate roadmap.

items.title: v1 scope, instructions and measurable completion criteria
evidence: README.md and ROADMAP.md: scope, limitations and fixed v1 weights

items.title: Engine, adapter and runner boundaries
evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: job workflow, responsibilities and result model

items.title: Installable package and working CLI entry point
evidence: Version 1.0.0 wheel and sdist built; source archive includes .NET/Android fixtures and wrapper, excludes generated outputs; installed wheel built a real PYZ and passed resource/runtime testing outside the checkout; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/installed-wheel-v1.json

items.title: Working CI with quality and progress consistency checks
evidence: All 15 jobs passed, including six Core matrix jobs, three native Python builds, packaged Windows GUI, Windows/Linux .NET builds, real Android APK/AAB, Windows profiles and Python-free execution, and aggregate release gate; https://github.com/Swir/Maxkompilator/actions/runs/39152793026; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/ci-release-v1.json

evidence: tests/test_detection.py: scripts, Python projects, Android projects and concrete csproj detection; local suite PASS  -  docs/VALIDATION.md

evidence: tests/test_detection.py: test_multiple_python_scripts_need_explicit_entry, test_mixed_directory_requires_explicit_kind, test_multiple_csprojects_require_concrete_project_path  -  PASS

items.title: Required tool diagnostics with actionable missing-tool messages
evidence: tests/test_engine.py: test_missing_tool_yields_failed_report_without_build; scripts/gui_smoke.py: environment_doctor_and_smoke_flag_scoping  -  local PASS

evidence: tests/test_engine.py: test_zipapp_builds_and_runs_with_resources_outside_source; real examples/hello-python PYZ and smoke test PASS on Linux  -  docs/VALIDATION.md

evidence: maxkompilator/adapters/python_adapter.py and a real example built and run with PyInstaller 6.22.3 on Linux  -  docs/VALIDATION.md

items.title: Real EXE with a valid format, resources and the built application's icon
evidence: Actual profiled Windows PE x64 with seven matching embedded icon payloads, version 1.0.0.0, resource and runtime PASS; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/profile-qualification.json

items.title: Run a built EXE on Windows without installing Python
evidence: Actual profiled EXE ran twice in a Windows Server Core container with no installed Python, no Python commands, executables or registry entries, and networking disabled. Both SHA-256 values match the inspected PE. CI job 117747360918 PASS; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/ci-profile/python-free-windows.json and source.json

items.title: Gradle recipes for debug APK/AAB and wrapper-based projects
evidence: Actual Gradle 8.11.1 / AGP 8.9.2 APK and AAB builds through Maxkompilator; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/apk-build-report.json and aab-build-report.json

items.title: Real APK: manifest, package, variant and signature verification
evidence: Actual Gradle 8.11.1 / AGP 8.9.2 APK build; SDK aapt manifest/package/version/debug and apksigner certificate/SHA-256 checks PASS; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/apk-build-report.json

items.title: Install and launch an APK on an emulator or phone
evidence: APK installed and launched twice on the Android API 36 x86_64 emulator; independent PIDs 2539/2713 each read the compiled resource and logged MAXKOMPILATOR_ANDROID_RUNTIME_OK; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/android-qualification.json

items.title: Real AAB and explicit debug/release signing distinction
evidence: Actual Gradle debug AAB built; unsigned state explicitly distinguished from production signing; bundletool 1.18.2 validate and decoded package/version/debug manifest comparison PASS; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/android-qualification.json and aab-build-report.json

items.title: dotnet publish adapter with an explicit project and target
evidence: Actual Windows and Linux self-contained .NET publishing passed in CI run 39151908070, plus local console and WinForms builds; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/dotnet-build-report.json and desktop-qualification.json

items.title: Publish a real .NET project and verify its output
evidence: Actual Windows self-contained net8.0 build through Maxkompilator; PE x64 apphost, resource, runtime DLLs and hashes PASS; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/dotnet-build-report.json and dotnet-qualification.json

items.title: Run the published application on Windows
evidence: Published 188-file application copied outside the sources and executed on Windows x64; MAXKOMPILATOR_DOTNET_RUNTIME_OK and matching copied-tree hashes PASS; docs/INTEGRATION_2026-10-18.md

items.title: Verify desktop application dependencies and distribution mode
evidence: Real self-contained WinForms application painted a window, read its resource and exited successfully after relocation; 465 published files include WindowsDesktop dependencies; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/desktop-qualification.json

items.title: Dark interface, original icon and by Swir attribution
evidence: Original multicolor 3D icon SHA-256 03ee456da8263cf1ed476a05c60d719948aaf41f8d81316798b73717893f381a preserved in final GUI; actual interactive Windows review and two final packaged launches passed; docs/images/gui-windows-v1.png and docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/packaged-gui/qualification.json

items.title: Project selection, diagnostics, planning and building from the GUI
evidence: Interactive Windows rc1 review selected and diagnosed a real WinForms project, built 465 published files and passed runtime/resource testing. Final 1.0.0 GUI additionally passed automated inspect, plan, doctor, PYZ build, cancellation and reopening; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/interactive-gui.json and packaged-gui/qualification.json

items.title: Responsive logs, background work and job cancellation
evidence: Final 1.0.0 GUI: background jobs, streamed logs, output/log controls, cancellation and descendant termination passed on both launches; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/packaged-gui/qualification.json

items.title: Complete Windows GUI workflow and relaunch test
evidence: Final 1.0.0 Windows bundle: two independent relocated GUI launches, 10 checks and 5 compiled workers per launch PASS; docs/evidence/windows-2026-10-18/packaged-gui/qualification.json. Interactive rc1 Windows review built and ran a real WinForms project and reopened the interface; interactive-gui.json records exact version and scope.
